A '''battle''' was fought between the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]] at the planet [[Thanos]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]]. After Teradoc tried to claim some of [[Zsinj]]'s territory for his own, Ackbar's forces drove Teradoc back and put him on the defense. Ackbar defeated Teradoc soundly at Thanos, ultimately leading to the collapse of Teradoc's warlord ambitions in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
